column1: # Geometric / classical SLAM counterfactual extension; metadata-only; truth remains evaluator-only.
# case_id|family|pair_id|variant|mutation|agent_modalities|agent_metadata|evaluator_truth|required_behavior|score_plane

avgeo001-001|frame_transform|pair-frame-transform-01|control|camera-to-world transform uses the correct frame direction and declared calibration revision|video+imu|frame IDs, transform revision, calibration digest and transform uncertainty|true camera/world transform and landmark world coordinates|transform observations only through the admitted direction/revision; preserve transform lineage|frame-correctness

avgeo001-002|frame_transform|pair-frame-transform-01|mutated|same numeric transform is applied in the inverse direction or wrong target frame|video+imu|same numeric matrix but mismatched source/target frame identity|true transform direction and frame graph|reject incompatible frame composition; do not publish allocentric coordinates|frame-mismatch-negative

avgeo001-003|pose_graph_cycle|pair-cycle-consistency-01|control|three relative pose constraints compose to identity within declared uncertainty|video+imu|relative transform edges, covariance/uncertainty and source references|true poses and cycle residual|accept loop closure only when cycle residual is within preregistered bound|pose-cycle-consistency

avgeo001-004|pose_graph_cycle|pair-cycle-consistency-01|mutated|one edge is corrupted so the closed transform cycle exceeds its uncertainty bound|video+imu|same graph with one altered transform digest/value|true poses and corrupted edge identity|retain/reject the inconsistent edge as a conflict; do not silently optimize it away|pose-cycle-negative

avgeo001-005|calibration_revision|pair-calibration-revision-01|control|observations reference the current camera intrinsics/extrinsics calibration revision|video|calibration artifact digest and revision ID|true sensor calibration and camera pose|use the admitted calibration for image-to-world projection|calibration-current

avgeo001-006|calibration_revision|pair-calibration-revision-01|mutated|map update reuses an older calibration after a camera or lens change|video|stale calibration revision and explicit device/profile change event|true changed calibration and resulting projection error|mark derived geometry stale and reproject/requalify before use|calibration-stale-negative

avgeo001-007|monocular_scale|pair-monocular-scale-01|control|monocular observations determine relative structure but no metric scale is available|video|monocular stream, relative pose and no scale anchor|true scene geometry up to similarity transform|report scale-ambiguous structure; do not claim metric distance|scale-observability

avgeo001-008|monocular_scale|pair-monocular-scale-01|mutated|candidate reports metric distance without a qualified scale anchor|video|same candidate-visible monocular evidence and no metric scale reference|true scale remains unobservable|reject unsupported metric scale; retain relative geometry or Unknown|false-metric-claim

avgeo001-009|loop_closure_geometry|pair-loop-geometry-01|control|revisited landmark has distinct visual, route and geometric support for the same place|video+imu|prior route, current viewpoint, candidate closure constraints|true repeated place and consistent pose graph|accept loop closure with its source/constraint receipt|loop-closure-supported

avgeo001-010|loop_closure_geometry|pair-loop-geometry-01|mutated|repeated texture resembles a prior landmark but route and pose constraints disagree|video+imu|similar local appearance but inconsistent route/geometry|true distinct place and incompatible transform|reject false loop closure or preserve competing place hypotheses|false-loop-closure

avgeo001-011|dynamic_scene_revision|pair-dynamic-scene-01|control|world layout remains stable while people and movable objects change across visits|video+imu|two sessions, entity tracks and camera trajectory|stable structural landmarks plus transient dynamic objects|preserve static map while revising transient entity state|lifelong-map-separation

avgeo001-012|dynamic_scene_revision|pair-dynamic-scene-01|mutated|candidate promotes a moved chair/person into a permanent structural map change|video+imu|same two sessions with moved transient objects|structural scene unchanged; transient objects changed|avoid false structural map revision; separate dynamic object state|false-map-change

avgeo001-013|map_revision|pair-map-revision-01|control|late evidence identifies a previously unknown doorway and supports a new topology edge|video|late observation interval and known-at time|doorway exists at valid time and correction arrival time|append a supported edge with valid/known-at metadata and source interval|map-correction

avgeo001-014|map_revision|pair-map-revision-01|mutated|late evidence shows an existing doorway edge was a visual misassociation|video|contradictory late observation and prior edge revision ID|no doorway between the two rooms; earlier edge was mistaken|retract/supersede the affected edge while preserving historical as-known map state|map-retraction

avgeo001-015|clock_alignment|pair-clock-alignment-01|control|camera and IMU timestamps use a qualified time transform with bounded residual|video+imu|clock-domain IDs/generations and transform calibration receipt|true offset/drift and sensor measurement times|fuse pose constraints only within the transform validity envelope|clock-qualified-fusion

avgeo001-016|clock_alignment|pair-clock-alignment-01|mutated|camera and IMU timestamps numerically coincide but belong to unrelated generations|video+imu|distinct clock generation IDs without admitted transform|true physical time relation is unknown/incomparable|do not fuse by equal timestamp; preserve incomparable temporal relation|clock-fusion-negative

avgeo001-017|ground_truth_provenance|pair-ground-truth-01|control|trajectory reference is independently captured by motion capture for the declared sequence|video+imu|reference source class, calibration, time alignment and capture run IDs|independent motion-capture pose reference|score against the admitted GT source with its uncertainty/provenance|ground-truth-lineage

avgeo001-018|ground_truth_provenance|pair-ground-truth-01|mutated|trajectory reference is produced by offline SLAM using the same sensor modality/root as the evaluated map|video+imu|reference method and common source root explicitly declared|shared-source derived reference, not independent physical GT|do not call this independent ground truth; qualify only relative consistency|ground-truth-common-cause

avgeo001-019|relocalization|pair-relocalization-01|control|agent revisits a prior scene after appearance/lighting change with consistent geometric constraints|video+imu|new session ID, prior map revision, pose/calibration and allowed history|same physical place and expected relocalization pose|relocalize with calibrated uncertainty and preserve map revision history|lifelong-relocalization

avgeo001-020|relocalization|pair-relocalization-01|mutated|visually similar different scene induces a confident relocalization to the prior map|video+imu|similar appearance but inconsistent geometry/route and scene identity|different physical place|reject false relocalization or abstain; do not merge maps by appearance alone|false-relocalization
